scope: V03 UI readability, interaction states, player pause feedback, and danmaku trail follow-up

codeChanges.summary: Move playback-rate menu surface/foreground rules out of the low-priority legacy layer; retain explicit readable hover, selected and focus states.
Reset the rotated volume range in legacy and desktop layers, including desktop min-height:0, so generic form styles cannot distort the thumb/track alignment.

pauseFeedback.note: The existing playerStyleArchitecture spec asserts compact centered feedback with no blur/shadow. This follow-up did not capture a new packaged-app screenshot.

themeContrast.notes: Automated checks cover registered theme text/surface combinations and several selected, hover, disabled, error, and action states. This is not a pixel audit of every rendered label on every route.

danmakuTrail.note: No live playback window or real danmaku stream was available during this V03 subtask; user-reported trail remains an open real-playback acceptance item.

routeDpiFocusMatrix.note: Existing source-level and component tests ran; this subtask did not exercise every route/theme at 100%, 125%, and 150% DPI, narrow widths, and keyboard-only focus in the packaged desktop app.

playbackRateMenu.issue: Its foreground and surface rules were previously in the legacy cascade layer and could lose to later shell/button rules.
playbackRateMenu.fix: Use a scoped unlayered rule with opaque elevated surface and explicit primary text; preserve semantic hover, selected and focus states.

volumeSlider.issue: Generic desktop form styles also matched input[type=range] in a higher-priority base layer, applying a 40px min-height and form surface to the rotated slider.
volumeSlider.fix: Add a narrow desktop-layer player range reset with min-height:0, transparent background, no border and no shadow; retain a high-specificity legacy reset for other shells.

workspaceWindowCaptureAttempt.observation: The workspace package launch produced no targetable window.
workspaceWindowCaptureAttempt.interpretation: Consistent with the previously documented AppContainer ACL issue on workspace install paths; not evidence of a playback failure. No second launch was attempted.

latestFocused.details: The second playerStyleArchitecture run was after the desktop-layer slider correction (12/12); the earlier two-file run covered rate menu and theme contrast (60/60).

remaining: Capture visible packaged-app screenshots for the full route/theme/focus matrix at 100%, 125%, and 150% DPI and narrow layouts.
Verify the reported danmaku trail during actual video playback, including pause/resume and dense-comment conditions.
